FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Harvest Market
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Fresh Harvest Market, we specialize in the retail of fresh fruits and vegetables, delivering high-quality, locally sourced produce to our customers. Our operations are centered around ensuring the freshness and safety of all products, as we maintain strict temperature and humidity controls in our storage and display areas to prevent spoilage. 

We have a trained staff dedicated to food safety practices, and conduct regular audits of our suppliers to ensure compliance with food safety standards. Our commitment to quality is further heightened by our proactive measures to document our processes and maintain consistent inspections of our refrigeration equipment, significantly reducing the risk of foodborne illnesses.

In addition, we ensure that all operations adhere to local health department regulations, maintaining all necessary certifications. Our sales channels include both in-store purchases and an online platform, where we also prioritize cyber liability coverage to protect customer data.

Overall, our operations focus on delivering outstanding customer service while upholding the highest standards of safety and quality in the market.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any unresolved or repeated food safety violations and confirms that all staff are thoroughly trained in food handling practices. We maintain strict temperature and humidity controls for all perishable inventory and confirm that we have the necessary auto liability insurance in place for our delivery vehicles.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
On 08/15/2022, we experienced a loss due to equipment failure resulting in spoilage of perishable goods valued at $2,500. The issue was investigated, and the refrigeration unit was replaced immediately to prevent future occurrences. The status is resolved.  
On 12/10/2022, we faced another loss due to a shipment delay affecting our fresh produce inventory, which resulted in a loss of $2,500. We have since established stronger communication protocols with our suppliers to mitigate such risks in the future. The status is resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard commercial safe, Class B, UL listed for cash and sensitive documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and on-site watchpersons for enhanced security and theft prevention.
